title: Project HS typed material graph v7
description: Bounded typed MaterialIR with numeric parameters, explicit samples, context adapters and typed closure layers. Skin subsurface and solid dielectric transmission use uniform optical profiles in metres; unsupported varying optical inputs fail compiler validation. Thin, subsurface and solid transport are mutually exclusive in this single-profile representation. Hero sampled-context adapters use no graph texture/sampler declarations. Environment ordinals remain fixed. Advanced tangent/coat/sheen/thin/emission families use requested sidecars. Arbitrary HLSL and bindless resources remain unsupported.
